breaking_changes_1_9.description:
Version 1.9 changed entities, states and options. Check your automations and scripts:

- The states of API status, presence, presence mode and weather are lowercase.
- Phone trackers report not_home instead of away, and unknown instead of not_tracking.
- Climate: the schedule preset and the next schedule, heating power and open window attributes are gone; separate entities replace them.
- Manual changes follow the setting of each room in the tado app instead of ending after 30 minutes.
- Device names are translated, and valves and sensors are connected via the Bridge X.
- Polling follows a daily API call budget instead of an update interval.

The release notes list every change. You can ignore this notice.
breaking_changes_1_9.title: tado X 1.9 changed entities and options

low_quota_tier.description: The tado account of {home} allows only {limit} API calls a day, so rooms update only about every {rooms_minutes} minutes. tado allows 20,000 calls a day with an Auto-Assist subscription.
low_quota_tier.title: Small tado API quota for {home}

not_tado_x_home.description: tado reports that {home} is not a tado X home, so this integration cannot control it. Remove this entry and add the home with the core tado integration.
not_tado_x_home.title: {home} is not a tado X home

quota_exhausted.description:
The tado API quota of the account used by {home} is used up. Until tado resets it at {reset}, the integration sends no requests, shows the last known values, and commands fail.

The tado app and other integrations on the same account use the same quota. If this happens often, lower the daily call budget in the options.
quota_exhausted.title: tado API quota used up for {home}

quota_low.description: Only {remaining} API calls of the account used by {home} are left, at or below the reserve of {reserve}. Rooms update at the slowest rate and optional data pauses until tado resets the quota. Commands still work.
quota_low.title: tado API quota low for {home}
